ios.desc: Discover the underground sounds of 90s techno, drum and bass, jungle, house, and vaporwave with .mixtape! Dive into a unique catalog of rare vinyl rips and hard-to-find tracks, meticulously curated for true fans of electronic dance music. Create your own mixtapes, explore by genre, and share your vibe with friends. Join the .mixtape community to keep the rave alive, wherever you are.
